evidence.claim: One shared full development interval is used by every candidate; no held-out evaluation split is present in this runner.
Complete-period measured-hard/no-valid-plan/unfilled counts gate eligibility before complete-period book return, MDD and turnover determine the winner.
The 64 adaptive candidates depend on eligible official-track complete-period exploration results, using return and MDD to select parents.
The candidate design imports earlier same-history winners from BOTH tracks; unchanged final parameters in PIT do not make that track design-independent.
The current final selection is solely official-track and the same parameter tuple is rerun in PIT; no separate PIT final winner is selected in this study.
The code explicitly labels development, ex-post official universe and blocked formal submission; the official track intentionally bypasses the historical universe known-at check.

Selection information from the latter interval can influence eligibility, the search neighborhood and the selected fixed parameters. This is selection reuse, not evidence of a bug in per-trade feature timing.
Prior anchors and repeated studies add adaptive history beyond the current 405 parameter tuples; 810 track-runs and search seeds are not independent market replications.

diagnostic_method.ledger: Every segment is extracted from the SAME continuous stored candidate ledger; no reset or stitched portfolio.
diagnostic_method.rank: Descending average rank; Spearman is Pearson correlation of these ranks.
diagnostic_method.top_decile: ceil(0.1*N); average-rank ties broken by candidate ID only for overlap.
cohorts: full-period eligible subset (future-conditioned; NOT a prospective candidate screen)
diagnostic_method.prohibited_interpretation: No causal out-of-sample return, no inferential p-value, no independent bootstrap replications; adaptive candidate membership and prior anchors already use both periods.
diagnostic_method.why_economic_primary: Avoid moving accrued distributions from receivables into final-period cash being mistaken for late-period investment skill.

supported_claims: Selected f0019 is the best declared full-period official-pool book return among this study's 11 measured-feasible candidates, under the frozen assumptions.
Final results have prior independent ledger and prefix validation; the current review verifies their stored hashes and selection use.
PIT same-parameter results are an in-development universe sensitivity check.
Stored-ledger rank stability is descriptive evidence of behavior within already-seen history.
unsupported_claims: Future or unseen/OOS expected performance is established.
Zero observed hard breaches implies future or complete formal compliance.
Selection leakage is absent because individual orders only use prior-close signals.
The official-vs-PIT comparison is an independent external validation.
The full 302.35% selected return is an unbiased estimate of deployable expected return.
Strong rank stability would remove adaptive-selection bias, or weak rank stability alone would prove a particular overfit probability.
conclusion: Selection reuse and adaptive-history exposure are verified. Generalization and the magnitude of overfit remain unmeasured; a fresh untouched forward interval is required to test them.

observations.scope: all 405, 2025 versus 2026 through September 21, economic NAV
observations.interpretation: Parameter ranking is not invariant across these already-seen regimes. This is not an overfit probability or an unbiased predictive test.

observations.scope: official 11 full-period eligible candidates; future-conditioned subset
observations.interpretation: The higher within-subset stability must be disclosed alongside the broad-cohort diagnostic, but future-period feasibility was used to define the subset.
